button "Asset links are what Deliver enriches in step 2. Asset-direct linking works even before any product or contract exists, so it solves the chicken-and-egg case."

button "Coverage = share of a concept scheme's concepts with at least one link. Products and Contracts are optional extra links, so the three counts don't sum to the total. Only Assets can be enriched in step 2."

button "Deliver writes your governed metadata onto the platform. Downstream tools (Genie, search, agents) read it from there. Tags = policy & discovery. Descriptions = what Genie reads. Glossary = the governed business layer."
button "Delivery platforms come from your configured connections in Settings. Unity Catalog is the default. The delivery targets below adapt to the platform you pick."
button "Large View: Advanced view reveals the ontology layer: RDF/SKOS, IRIs, property domain & range, and technical delivery settings. Simple hides them. Your choice is remembered."
